fields.statement: At 01f5053a: go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/daemon-milestone-request -count=1 -v passes; the new script queues a feature then a milestone request with a Claude transcript filling the 1000-token session limit: with rhiza.daemon.paused true and with RHIZA_TEST_FREE_BYTES at 1GiB (disk-low) daemon --once starts nothing (no detach.log), and under the usage hold it starts only the milestone request's plan run while 'Add exports' stays queued (oldest-first order makes this discriminating). go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run Usage passes (incl. TestUsageHoldStopsLaunches and TestUsageHoldStopsEveryLaunch, which still holds a feature request), as do TestScripts/usage-hold and TestDaemonPlanRequests*. Diff read: daemonPoll1 now returns early only on paused||low; under a hold it skips resumes, ship picks, queued continues and queued starts, and calls daemonPlanRequests with onlyKind=milestone, which skips other kinds.
